LiftIron is in Grok Bot.
Not a logbook. A strength coach in chat.
Tell it the last set. It calls the next weight and reps, estimates your one-rep max, and flags the deload before the plateau owns you.
Same progression rules as the app. No account. No quiz.https://t.co/PjfoT0lTNV…
